business_scope.primary_industry_name: Distribution of Excess Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors and Resistors

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (TW), cross-strait sub-state jurisdiction for investor and operational nexus
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law / Hybrid - PRC national law governs the WFOE, while Taiwan commercial law governs the Taiwanese investor's corporate lex societatis
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), signed 29 Jun 2010, effective 12 Sep 2010
Cross-Strait Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement, signed 9 Aug 2012, effective 1 Feb 2013

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of the People's Republic of China on Anti-Money Laundering (revised and adopted 26 Oct 2024, effective 1 Jan 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (People's Bank of China and State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 Nov 2024); Measures for Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Supervision and Administration of Financial Institutions (PBOC Order No. 1 [2021]); Counter-Terrorism Law of the PRC (2018 amendment); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (effective 1 Jan 2020); Company Law of the PRC (2023 revision, effective 1 Jul 2024); for the Taiwanese investor, Taiwan's Money Laundering Control Act and the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission beneficial ownership provisions apply investor-side.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Company Registration Certificate of the Taiwanese Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial Registration Office, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention state, therefore the exclusive route is the cross-strait consular-legalization-analogue: Taiwan notary public -> Straits Exchange Foundation verification -> mainland-designated cross-strait notarization verification office. If the same document were issued in an Apostille Convention state, the sole authentication path would be a Hague Apostille by that state's competent authority; the two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Current Registration Status of the Taiwanese Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taiwan (Company Registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-origin document: Taiwan notary public -> Straits Exchange Foundation verification -> mainland-designated cross-strait notarization verification office. For an Apostille Convention issuer, only a Hague Apostille from the designated competent authority is required. Consular legalization and apostille must not be combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Taiwanese Investor authorizing incorporation of the WFOE and Power of Attorney in favor of the formation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Taiwanese Investor, notarized before a Taiwan notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-strait verification path for Taiwan-issued corporate acts: Taiwan notary public -> Straits Exchange Foundation verification -> mainland cross-strait notarization verification office. Alternative, mutually exclusive path for an Apostille-state issuer: Hague Apostille only. No sequential chaining with consular legalization is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of the Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents of the Taiwanese Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs Company Registry or a Taiwan notary public holding the certified corporate records
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-origin certified copy: Taiwan notary public -> Straits Exchange Foundation verification -> mainland cross-strait notarization verification office. If issued in an Apostille Convention state, the competent authority's Hague Apostille is the exclusive authentication. The consular legalization path applies only to non-Apostille states outside the cross-strait mechanism.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Taiwanese Investor including account relationship, creditworthiness, and source-of-funds confirmation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Principal licensed banking institution of the Taiwanese Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank counter-signature followed by the cross-strait verification route for Taiwan-origin documents: Taiwan notary public -> Straits Exchange Foundation verification -> mainland cross-strait notarization verification office. For a bank located in an Apostille Convention state, the sole path is Hague Apostille of the bank officer's notarized signature; never chain apostille with consular legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All persons with ownership or control of 25% or more of the WFOE, all directors, legal representatives, senior management, authorized signatories, and material counterparty representatives must be screened continuously against (i) the PBOC and Ministry of Public Security AML/CFT lists, (ii) the SAMR serious-abnormal-operation and dishonesty lists, (iii) the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, (iv) OFAC SDN and consolidated non-SDN sanctions lists, (v) the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission AML database and Taiwan targeted financial sanctions lists, and (vi) adverse media and negative news. PEP screening covers domestic Chinese, Taiwan-region, and foreign PEPs, their immediate family members, and close associates. Any positive hit, PEP status beyond de minimis, or unexplained source of wealth mandates enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, source-of-funds documentation, and potential suspicious transaction reporting within the statutory period.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and the State Administration for Market Regulation enterprise name reservation service (www.gsxt.gov.cn)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory company names must be in simplified Chinese characters. Traditional Chinese characters, pinyin-only names, and English-only names are not acceptable for the registered Chinese entity name. For a WFOE, the foreign investor's legal name must be transliterated into standard simplified-Chinese phonetics and embedded in the distinctive segment. The statutory four-tier SAMR name structure is: administrative division + distinctive word or transliterated investor name + industry description + organisational form. The organisational form must be limited liability company. A foreign-language trade alias may be used in contracts and banking documents but is not registered by SAMR as the statutory company name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a name reservation application, the applicant must receive a written decision stating the statutory grounds. An internal administrative review with the superior market regulation bureau can be filed within 15 days from receipt of the decision. If the internal review fails, administrative reconsideration may be filed with the State Administration for Market Regulation within 60 days, and judicial review with the competent people's court within 6 months. The applicant may also immediately file a corrected name application. The 30-day

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), including the sections on incorporation conditions, registered capital subscription and governance of limited liability companies (Articles 23, 24, 47 and 68); Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4, 12 and 31, as applied to Taiwan-area investors by reference; Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Registration Administration of Market Entities (2021), Articles 5, 9, 15 and 20; and the Foreign Investment Negative List, under which wholesale distribution of passive electronic components is an unrestricted permitted category.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the local Market Regulation Administration of the city where the WFOE's registered office is established; the electronic filing platform is the National Enterprise Registration One-Stop Service portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Wholly Foreign-Owned Limited Liability Company, together with the duly executed Articles of Association, filed in the SAMR online enterprise registration system; the issuance of the Comprehensive Business License constitutes the statutory incorporation instrument.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. The PRC Company Law does not impose a minimum paid-up capital for a WFOE engaged in wholesale distribution of electronic components. The registered capital amount is determined by the Articles of Association and must be fully subscribed by the sole member, with actual contribution made within five years from establishment as required by Article 47 of the Company Law. No blocked escrow account is required for this activity; capital may be contributed in RMB or a freely convertible foreign currency through a SAFE-registered capital account, and the Taiwan-area investor must document the source of funds for bank compliance purposes.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF CN WFOE LTD (THE 'COMPANY'), ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE SOLE MEMBER ACTING IN ITS CAPACITY AS THE COMPOSITION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, PURSUANT TO THE COMPANY LAW OF THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA AND THE COMPANY'S ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION. THIS RESOLUTION SHALL BE RECORDED IN THE COMPANY'S RESOLUTION BOOK AND FILED WITH THE STATE ADMINISTRATION FOR MARKET REGULATION. WHEREAS the Company was formed for the purpose of wholesale distribution of passive electronic components, including multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors; and WHEREAS the sole Member has subscribed the entire registered capital of the Company and wishes to formalize the first governance acts. NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS: 1. Capital Subscription and Capital Contribution. The Board acknowledges that the sole Member has subscribed to 100% of the registered capital of the Company in the amount of RMB [AMOUNT]. The Board instructs the Legal Representative and the General Manager to arrange for the contribution of such capital in accordance with the capital contribution schedule in the Articles of Association and Article 47 of the Company Law, to open any required capital contribution account, and to cause the capital to be deposited through lawful banking channels, including the required foreign exchange registration with the designated bank under the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. 2. Banking Authorization. The Board authorizes the opening of a basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account with [NAME OF BANK]. Each instruction on the said accounts shall require the signature of the Legal Representative and the Financial Controller as joint signatories, provided that any payment not exceeding RMB [AMOUNT] may be effected by the single signature of the Legal Representative. The bank is irrevocably authorized to honor all instruments bearing such signatures and to act in accordance with the Company's account opening resolutions. 3. Registered Office. The Board adopts the premises located at [FULL ADDRESS] as the registered office and principal place of business of the Company. The Legal Representative is authorized to execute and deliver the lease, occupancy certificates, and any property-related declarations, and to file such address with all registration authorities, including SAMR and the tax authority. 4. Statutory Officer Appointments. The Board appoints [NAME] as Executive Director and Legal Representative, [NAME] as Supervisor, and [NAME] as General Manager and Chief Financial Officer. The Supervisor is appointed to exercise audit and compliance oversight under the Company Law. The Legal Representative, the General Manager, and the Chief Financial Officer are jointly and severally authorized, within the limits of law, to execute all incorporation documents, lease agreements, banking mandates, employment agreements, tax filings, utilities contracts, and other ordinary course instruments. 5. Effectiveness. This resolution shall take effect immediately upon adoption and may be relied upon by any governmental authority, bank, or third party dealing with the Company. Passed by unanimous consent on [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation Name Clearance and Business Scope Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration of the city where the registered office will be located, acting through the SAMR National Enterprise Registration One-Stop Service portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Taiwan-area investor shall submit the proposed company name in Chinese, which must include the geographic reference, the descriptor 'Electronic Component Wholesale,' and the limited liability suffix. The business scope shall be drafted as 'wholesale distribution of passive electronic components, including multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors; no manufacturing or assembly activity is declared.' The system will automatically screen duplicates and prohibited words. Because the activity falls within a permitted foreign-investment category, no pre-license is required. The online application must be signed by the designated representative using the personal digital certificate; no notarization is required at this stage. The applicant should verify that the requested name does not conflict with existing trademarks or enterprises and that the scope wording matches the SAMR industry classification dictionary.
required_dossiers: Completed enterprise name pre-registration application form
Identity or registration documents of the Taiwan-area investor
Power of attorney for the designated representative
Proposed business scope description in Simplified Chinese
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is rejected or suspended because of identity, similarity, or prohibited-word findings, the applicant may submit up to two revised alternative names within 10 working days through the same portal; if the suspension exceeds 20 working days without a written decision, the applicant may file a written complaint with the local SAMR or seek administrative reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Cross-Strait Authentication of the Taiwan-Area Investor Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan notary public office and, where applicable, the authorized cross-strait notarization and authentication channel; the authenticated copies are then submitted to mainland registration authorities and banks.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Taiwan-area investor must notarize its certificate of incorporation or institution file, current director list, shareholder identity documents, and the board or owner resolution authorizing the creation of the PRC WFOE. The notarized documents are then processed through the Straits Exchange Foundation verification procedure and the corresponding mainland authentication channel. All Traditional Chinese or English documents must be accompanied by a Simplified Chinese translation prepared by a qualified translator, and both the original and translation shall be bound with the notarization certificate. The applicant must retain duplicate authenticated copies for the SAMR submission and the bank capital account opening. This step ensures the legal validity of a Taiwan-area shareholder in the PRC foreign investment registration and prevents rejection at later administrative or banking stages.
required_dossiers: Notarized Taiwan-area company registration certificate or institution file
Notarized board resolution of the Taiwan-area investor authorizing the WFOE investment
Passport or Taiwan resident identity document of the authorized signatory
Certified Simplified Chinese translation of all notarized documents
Power of attorney for mainland filing agents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarization or authentication is returned for correction, the applicant must re-notarize and resubmit the package within 30 days; if a translation discrepancy is identified, the applicant must cure it with a revised notarized translation before any further filing; if the authentication authority is delayed, the applicant may request a written progress notice and use that notice to support a grace request at the SAMR window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment Registration Submission to the Local Market Regulation Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration (SAMR) having jurisdiction over the registered office address of the WFOE.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the application for establishment of a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company through the online one-stop platform or in person. Execute the Articles of Association before submission and attach the verified Taiwan-area shareholder documents. The application must include the registered capital amount, the five-year contribution schedule, the business scope restricted to wholesale distribution of passive electronic components, and the designated legal representative and supervisor. The address dossier must include the lease agreement, the landlord's property ownership certificate, and a floor plan for the office or inventory storage area. After approval, SAMR issues the Comprehensive Business License with a unified social credit code that integrates tax, statistics, social insurance, and customs codes, thereby completing the statutory incorporation.
required_dossiers: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company
Company Articles of Association executed by the sole member
Authenticated Taiwan-area shareholder qualification documents
Certificate of identity and appointment letters for the legal representative and supervisor
Registered office lease agreement and property ownership certificate
Power of attorney for the designated representative
Material authenticity commitment letter signed by the investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration application is queried, the applicant must provide written explanations and supplementary evidence within 15 working days; if the authority issues a rejection notice, the applicant may re-apply after correcting the deficiencies or seek administrative reconsideration within 60 days; if the authority fails to decide within the statutory period, the applicant may register a complaint through the SAMR 12315 administrative channel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Engraving, Bank Account Opening, and SAFE Foreign Direct Investment Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving services; the chosen commercial bank; and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange acting through the bank's capital project information system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Comprehensive Business License, the Company shall engage a legally authorized seal engraving service to create the company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal, and contract seal; the seal impressions must be recorded with the public security file. The Company shall open a basic deposit account, a general RMB account, and a foreign exchange capital account at a bank empowered to conduct SAFE capital project registration. Complete the Foreign-Invested Enterprise Foreign Exchange Registration (FDI) through the bank, disclosing the Taiwan-area investor's equity structure and the proposed capital injection. The Taiwan-area shareholder's outward remittance must be settled into the capital account and the capital contribution receipt must be recorded in the financial books. If inventory will be imported, the Company must complete customs registration through the China International Trade Single Window.
required_dossiers: Comprehensive Business License
Articles of Association
Company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal, and contract seal impressions
Legal representative identity document and passport
Registered office lease agreement and property ownership certificate
FDI foreign exchange registration application form
Bank account opening forms and anti-money-laundering KYC questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or SAFE portal flags the application for lack of proof of source of funds, the applicant must provide bank statements, capital source declarations, and a compliance letter from the Taiwan-area investor; if the bank refuses the account, the Company may select another SAFE-designated bank without a new SAFE approval, provided that the corporate structure remains unchanged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Activation, Social Insurance Registration, and Statutory Compliance Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local branch of the State Taxation Administration, local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, and the Market Regulation Administration for annual reporting and post-registration supervision.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Although the multi-license integration automatically creates tax and social insurance records, the Company must activate its electronic tax bureau account and obtain a tax registration password; declare its taxpayer qualification as a general VAT taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer; and register the VAT, corporate income tax, and payroll schedules. The Company shall submit the payroll and social insurance contribution list and maintain statutory books including capital contribution records, board resolutions, bank mandates, and annual reports. If the WFOE will engage in direct electronic component imports or exports, complete customs declaration registration. The Company must also file the annual market subject report before 30 June of each subsequent year through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and maintain the registered address and statutory officers in the public registry.
required_dossiers: Comprehensive Business License
Bank account opening notice and bank mandate forms
Articles of Association
Legal representative identity document
Payroll list and social insurance registration forms
VAT general taxpayer application if applicable
Customs registration form if importing or exporting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax activation is delayed by a data mismatch between the SAMR and tax systems, the applicant may submit a manual correction through the local tax service hall or the 12366 tax service hotline; for social insurance discrepancies, use the one-stop correction form at the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; for annual reporting errors, file a correction through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System before the publication date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable. The WFOE's primary activity is wholesale distribution of passive electronic components (ISIC 4652), which is not listed on the PRC Negative List for Foreign Investment Access and does not require an industry operating permit. If a dedicated physical warehouse is established later, the local Municipal Emergency Management Bureau (fire rescue section) and the local Ecology and Environment Bureau attain limited competence over fire safety and solid waste management, respectively.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable – no separate operating license is required for the wholesale distribution and inventory resale of multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors. The Comprehensive Business License issued by SAMR is the only permit required to commence and conduct this trade activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable at formation. If future activities introduce a new construction project such as a self-built warehouse exceeding statutory thresholds, the local Ecology and Environment Bureau under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment becomes the competent agency for environmental filing or review.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable/Exempt – the wholesale distribution of passive electronic components does not trigger a Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report or an Environmental Impact Registration Form under the PRC Classification Management List of Environmental Impact Assessment for Construction Projects. Storage of dry, non-hazardous electronic components does not produce industrial wastewater, waste gas, or hazardous waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable at formation. If a warehouse is later operated, no quantitative wastewater, VOC, or hazardous-waste discharge threshold applies because no manufacturing, chemical plating, soldering, or battery processing occurs. Any generated e-waste, packaging waste, or discarded inventory must be separately collected and delivered to licensed recyclers under the Solid Waste Law; warehouse noise, lighting, and housekeeping must meet local municipal hygiene standards.

stage_2.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable to an office and trade-only operation. If the WFOE later maintains a physical inventory warehouse or bonded storage facility, the premises must pass a fire-protection filing or acceptance inspection by the fire rescue authority of the local Emergency Management Bureau, including maintenance of fire extinguishers, emergency exits, emergency lighting, and evacuation plans. Storage racks exceeding applicable height thresholds must undergo structural load inspection, and the employer must comply with the Work Safety Law, conduct regular occupational safety training, and obtain a workplace safety clearance where local regulations require it.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; tax filings and proceedings are conducted through the STA's National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax Bureau) platform, with the local competent tax bureau determined by the WFOE's registered address.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The WFOE, as a PRC-resident limited liability company, obtains its statutory taxpayer identification number through the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). The procedure is: (1) register the WFOE with SAMR and obtain the business license with a legally valid USCC; (2) within 30 calendar days of business license issuance, perform tax registration at the local competent tax authority via the e-Tax Bureau, linking the USCC to the tax filing account; (3) where export operations are contemplated, register the enterprise for customs declaration with China Customs and obtain an operating customs registration code; (4) enrol for VAT general taxpayer status in accordance with the statutory requirements through the e-Tax Bureau if annual taxable sales exceed the threshold or voluntarily; (5) obtain the required export foreign-exchange receipt accounts with a PRC bank and complete SAFE trade-in-foreign-exchange registration; (6) where the WFOE is not yet formed, a foreign non-resident investor cannot itself obtain a PRC TIN; the PRC TIN arises only after the WFOE has been incorporated and holds its USCC.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; PRC corporate income tax law does not provide check-the-box or pass-through election mechanisms, and no hybrid mismatch election is domestically recognized. The only practical entity-level election is the VAT general taxpayer vs. small-scale taxpayer status election, which does not alter corporate tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) of the People's Republic of China
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All WFOEs must complete tax and VAT registration from establishment irrespective of turnover; the mandatory VAT general taxpayer registration threshold is cumulative annual taxable sales exceeding CNY 5,000,000. Below that threshold, a WFOE may be treated as a small-scale taxpayer subject to the simplified VAT rate, unless general taxpayer status is voluntarily chosen.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China's electronic invoicing regime is governed by the Golden Tax Project Phase IV and the Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoice (FDEI) system. VAT special invoices and ordinary invoices are issued through the National Unified Electronic Invoice Service Platform, either via the web portal or through approved API-based integration, and are uploaded to the STA in near real time. Each FDEI carries a legally binding electronic signature, a unique invoice code and number, and is subject to STA's automatic anti-fraud verification and post-issuance fiscal clearance reconciliation against VAT filings and Customs export records. Paper invoices have been substantially replaced; no separate decal or digital stamp is required beyond the FDEI's cryptographic electronic mark.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods from the PRC customs territory, including shipped goods to the Taiwan area, may be VAT zero-rated if the WFOE is a VAT general taxpayer, the sale is a genuine export sale, goods are physically shipped out of PRC customs territory under export customs declaration, the export invoice and supporting documents are consistent, export proceeds are received from overseas buyers and repatriated to the PRC within the statutory deadline, and all required export tax rebate declaration data is submitted via e-tax and customs systems. The zero-rating covers output VAT at 0% and allows refund or credit of input VAT attributable to the export, subject to the verified export documentation bundle.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: China Customs Export Goods Declaration (Customs export declaration / Bill of Entry)
Bill of Lading, sea waybill, air waybill, or multimodal transport document evidencing export shipment
Export sales contract or overseas purchase order
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or bank foreign-exchange receipt confirmation issued by a PRC bank under SAFE rules
Zero-rated VAT export invoicing record as required under STA electronic invoice rules
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If STA or China Customs determines that export zero-rating is unsupported or fraudulent, the output VAT will be restored at the statutory 13% rate, the refunded input VAT will be clawed back in full, plus daily late-payment surcharge (0.05% per day) and an administrative fine ranging from 50% to 500% of the tax refund under the PRC Tax Administration Law. Fraudulent export tax rebate cases may additionally trigger Customs penalties, revocation of export tax rebate and customs registration qualification, and criminal prosecution under the PRC Criminal Law for fraudulent export tax rebate, carrying fines and imprisonment up to life imprisonment in serious circumstances.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), with delegated administration by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime with effective convertibility of the renminbi (CNY) on current-account items, while capital-account transactions remain strictly licensed and supervised by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE). A WFOE is treated as a foreign-invested enterprise and may open an FDI foreign-exchange capital account after completing FDI registration. Injected capital received in foreign currency can be settled into RMB for legitimate operating purposes listed on the negative-list and under the capital-funding account use rules, but the settled funds cannot be used for non-operating financial investments, real-estate speculation outside the permitted scope, or on-lending. The current-account profit remittance route permits distribution of after-tax profits subject to a statutory audit, tax filing and clearance, and payment through a designated bank with a profits remittance declaration. The practical hurdles include the need to evidence the underlying trade for every goods receipt and payment, the opaque but disciplined reporting of receipt/payment dates in the trade monitoring system, and the inability to freely hold and move overseas proceeds outside the banking channel. Dividend remittances from Taiwan-invested WFOEs also require verification of the investor's identity and source of funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's trade-in-goods foreign exchange administration, export earnings must be repatriated to a domestic current-account foreign-exchange account at a designated foreign-exchange bank. The standard statutory collection window is the export customs declaration date plus 90 days; if the receipt is not collected within 90 days, the WFOE must file a delayed-collection report in the SAFE Trade Monitoring System within 30 days after the due date. No fixed mandatory conversion ratio exists, so export proceeds may be retained in foreign currency for eligible current-account outflows or converted into CNY at the bank's offering rate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account (Capital Escrow Account)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account (Operational Currency Account)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Viability is low. Fintech EMIs (e.g., global borderless banking providers and digital money issuers) are not licensed by PBOC as designated foreign-exchange banks, and they cannot legally open a PRC capital account or perform FDI SAFE registration on behalf of a WFOE. They can only supply ancillary payment cards or e-wallets for already-settled transactions where the underlying funds flow through a licensed domestic bank, and the legal responsibility remains with the WFOE. Therefore, the treasury should rely exclusively on tier-1 licensed banks for all cross-border access and FX flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative or a senior officer with an original notarized power of attorney must appear physically in-branch for corporate account opening and KYC interview at most PBOC-regulated banks. Remote consular proxy opening is not generally permitted for a newly formed WFOE; some pilot free-trade zones allow remote video authentication after the bank has physically inspected the office and confirmed the directors' original identification documents, but this is issuer-decided and not a legal right.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The beneficial ownership chain is material and includes a Taiwan-registered parent with multi-layered holding structures, increasing the risk of disguised ownership and unhosted capital entry.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Association of each holding company; UBO register showing all natural persons with 25% or greater control; passports and permanent address proof for all UBOs; notarized board resolutions approving the WFOE formation and capital injection; FATCA/CRS tax residency forms; signed source-of-wealth questionnaire supported by audited financial statements and tax filings of the Taiwan parent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The trading profile of excess multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors can mask trade-based money laundering through over/under-invoicing, phantom inventory, and triangular shipment schemes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original purchase orders and invoices mapped to each customs export/import declaration; Bills of Lading and Air Waybills with matched weight/tariff codes; third-party pre-shipment inspection reports with quantities, part numbers and shipper details; warehouse inventory in/out records with externally signed delivery notes; a price benchmark report comparing transactions to reputable electronics distributor pricing for excess MLCC/resistor inventories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The WFOE is newly formed with no operating history and is already requesting substantial trade credit lines combined with inbound FDI capital, which may be interpreted as an artificial liquidity buffer or structuring facility.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved 24-month cash flow and balance sheet projection; signed sales contracts or letters of intent from OEM/CM customers; rental and utility invoices proving physical substance; payroll records and social insurance filings for planned staff; prior-period dormant tax returns if the entity has been registered but inactive; a factual narrative of why inventory acquisition must precede sales revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border movement of electronic components may raise export-control, sanctions and non-proliferation concerns if the inventory is ultimately diverted to military, nuclear or other prohibited end-uses.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Denied-party screening certificates from the WFOE and all counterparties against OFAC, EU, UN, UK and PRC restricted lists; ECCN determination letters or EAR99 classifications from the original manufacturers; end-user and end-use certificates from buyers with restriction on onward re-export; internal compliance policy; evidence that no entity in the transaction chain is subject to active sanctions; if applicable, government export licences for listed controlled dual-use items.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Taiwan-based investor shall remit the paid-in capital via a standard SWIFT MT103 from its Taiwan bank to the WFOE's FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account at the chosen tier-1 bank. The remittance must specify the SAFE foreign-exchange purpose code for foreign-invested enterprise capital contribution (e.g., 622011), refer to the FDI Foreign Exchange Registration Certificate and the WFOE's Unified Social Credit Code, and be accompanied by the underlying board resolution and investment agreement. After receipt, the receiving bank will verify the funds against the SAFE registration, complete settlement into CNY if needed, and, where requested, provide a proof-of-capital receipt. A Chinese CPA capital verification report should be prepared for the paid-in capital component when the foreign-invested enterprise law has been complied with conventional banking practice. If the injection is denominated in RMB, it must flow through a cross-border RMB clearing channel (CIPS or designated agent bank) using the same FDI registration and purpose code.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound inventory payments and supplier settlements, the preferred rails are SWIFT MT103 direct wire for open-account obligations, Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C at sight) for the smallest counterparty risk, and Documentary Collections (D/P, D/A) for repeat and well-rated vendors. Each disbursement must be matched to a corresponding trade document set: invoice, packing list, transport document, customs declaration, and, where credit is available, the correct BOP transaction code for goods import/export. Cross-border RMB payments to qualified suppliers may be cleared through CIPS, but all forex payments must be executed through the designated bank and recorded in the SAFE trade monitoring system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/CNY deliverable FX forwards with genuine current-account trade exposure and SAFE/PBOC dealer bank documentation; speculative forwards without underlying trade are prohibited.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps to hedge foreign-currency debt or matching long-term inventory receivables, provided the exposure is verifiable and the swap is concluded with a designated bank and reported to SAFE.
Offshore NDFs are not permitted onshore; the WFOE should not transact non-deliverable forwards offshore to hedge CNY, as SAFE does not recognize them for corporate treasury settlements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting (AGM) and adoption of financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders; resolution filed with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Services
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the close of the fiscal year, i.e. no later than 30 June of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: New Taiwan Dollars (TWD) 10,000 to 50,000 fine imposed on responsible officers for failing to convene the AGM within the statutory period; repeated failure may result in an administrative order for dissolution under Company Act Article 10

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of audited or annual financial statements after shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Services
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within fifteen days after approval at the AGM, and in all cases no later than 15 July if the AGM is held on 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: TWD 10,000 to 50,000 fine for late filing; persistent default may trigger compulsory deregistration or administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: From 1 May to 31 May of the following calendar year, or 1 June if 31 May falls on a weekend
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late pay surcharge of 1% of the tax due for every two days overdue up to 30 days; thereafter compulsory enforcement; under-reporting penalty of up to three times the underpaid amount

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, via the Beneficial Ownership Information Registration System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: TWD 10,000 to 500,000 fine for late or inaccurate declaration; serious or repeated violations may subject responsible persons to criminal penalties under the Money Laundering Control Act

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Prior-year withholding tax statement and employee remittance summary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty TWD 1,500 to 15,000; under-withholding penalty up to 10% of the tax shortfall, plus interest

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit is mandatory under Taiwan Company Act Article 20 and related rules if any one of the following quantitative thresholds is met: (a) paid-in capital exceeding NTD 30 million; (b) net operating revenue exceeding NTD 100 million; (c) 100 or more employees. Publicly listed or issuing entities are always subject to mandatory audit by a CPA licensed in Taiwan. Additionally, financial institutions and certain regulated industries are audited regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the Financial Supervisory Commission (Taiwan) for public and listed companies. Non-public WFOE subsidiaries may apply Taiwan SME Enterprise Accounting Standards, which align with IFRS for SMEs, or elect to apply full Taiwan IFRS. All financial statements are prepared in New Taiwan Dollars.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A Taiwan-incorporated WFOE must file its beneficial ownership information, including ultimate natural-person controllers, entity structure, and shareholding percentage details, electronically with the Ministry of Economic Affairs every year by 31 January. Any change in shareholding or ownership structure, such as a transfer of 25% or more of shares or change of ultimate beneficial owner, must be filed with the company registry within 30 days of the event, together with the necessary supporting resolutions and amended registers. Failure triggers fines and possible criminal liability under anti-money laundering regulations.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders' and Directors' Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 10,000 per year for a typical WFOE disregarded for consolidation; exact fee depends on transaction volume and complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% territorial net-income tax (Article 5 Income Tax Act), plus a 5% retained-earnings surtax on undistributed annual profits; low-rate AMT of 12% applies where the regular effective rate falls below 12%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for pure distributor (ISIC 4652); targeted credits under the Statute for Industrial Innovation (R&D, 5G, energy storage) are generally inapplicable to passive MLCC/resistor reselling; benefits limited to free-trade-zone and offshore-export regimes conditional on proven operational substance

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Income Tax Return (營利事業所得稅結算申報書) using the general Form 15 or the CPA-attested Form 20; electronic filing is compulsory via the Ministry of Finance e-Government tax portal (財政部電子申報繳稅服務網); transfer-pricing reporting statement attached in the same e-package
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (fiscal-year based), with two interim prepayment installments payable in the 8th and 12th months of the fiscal year
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing must be submitted within 5 months after the fiscal year-end (for December 31 year-end: by May 31); electronic submissions may be filed until 31 May 23:59; a one-month extension is grantable for CPA-audited accounts, with delay interest accruing on the unpaid balance

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from sale of goods (wholesale and distribution of passive electronic inventory)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross invoice sales booked through the Taiwanese WFOE; include FOB/Ex-Works and foreign-warehouse sales actually executed administratively by the Taiwan entity; exclude sales booked by the PRC parent before title transfer

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross profit after cost of goods sold (COGS)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach inventory movement schedule for MLCCs and resistors; cost must be evidenced by customs declarations and intercompany purchase invoices at arm's-length purchase prices

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses and losses (selling, administrative, R&D)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apportion cross-border management fees, IT services, and head-office allocations strictly under the approved Taiwan TP study; disallow payments lacking TRC or supporting services documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net profit / statutory taxable income before AMT and deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile with audited financial statements and the CPA-attested transfer-pricing adjustment; foreign-sourced service income of a non-PE permanent establishment must be separated from Taiwan-sourced trading income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Undistributed earnings subject to 5% retained-earnings surtax or dividend distribution recognised in the year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Choose between paying the 5% surtax on retained profits or distributing dividends to the PRC parent and triggering 21% withholding; the distribution election is made on this schedule and drives the Form 5 withholding payment

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file a self-assessed return: additional tax plus a penalty of 10% of the assessed tax (minimum NT$1,500). Underdecaration discovered in audit: 2x penalty on the underpaid tax; fraudulent concealment: 3x. Late payment: 30-day grace, then a 1% monthly delay surcharge (maximum 15%). Failure to e-file or to attach the TP statement: discrete fine of NT$3,000–NT$30,000 and an automatic TP audit trigger

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% on dividends distributed to non-resident corporate shareholders (including the PRC parent); resident Taiwanese corporate shareholders are tax-exempt; no imputation credit system remains
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No effective tax treaty between China and Taiwan; the 2015 Cross-Strait Tax Agreement (海峽兩岸避免雙重課稅及加強稅務合作協議) is signed but not in force and confers no decreasable rate; a PRC parent cannot invoke treaty relief. For treaty-jurisdiction shareholders, relief requires submission of the Taiwanese Tax Residence Certificate (TRC), the counterparty TRC, and a withholding-app reversal application to the National Taxation Bureau before the withholding payment, or a post-filing refund within 5 years of payment
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid by the WFOE to a non-resident company without a Taiwanese PE: 20% statutory WHT (treaty naes reduce this to 0%–10% where applicable; none for PRC licensors). Interest on shareholder/bank loans from non-residents: 20% statutory WHT; treaty cap generally 10%; short-term commercial-paper interest is 15% under domestic law

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File mandatory when cross-border related-party purchases/sales of goods reach NT$100 million annually or other related-party transacts (service fees, royalties, interest) reach NT$50 million; Master File mandatory when annual revenue exceeds NT$500 million and cross-border related-party volumes reach NT$100 million; declaration of all related-party transactions is due with the CIT return and full documentation must be produced within 30 days of the tax bureau's request
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan applies the substance-over-form doctrine and GAAR under Article 12-1 of the Tax Collection Act: a buy-sell distributor that holds title only on paper, carries no inventory risk, has no Taiwan warehouse, and executes no real procurement or logistic functions will be re-characterised as a mere conduit; the bureau may then impute a deemed profit margin (normally 10%–15% of wholesaling revenue), reject the intercompany mark-up, and add a 2x–3x penalty

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion – Fraudulent Understatement of Sales or Inflated COGS
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately recording fictitious purchase invoices, understating MLCC/resistor sales volume, channelling revenue through untaxed offshore accounts, or submitting a materially false annual return to reduce the taxable income of the WFOE
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of up to 5 years (Tax Evasion and Tax Collection Act Article 41), detention and/or fine up to NT$60,000; civil assessment of the evaded tax plus interest and an administrative fine equal to 2x (negligence) or 3x (intentional concealment) of the underpaid tax; denial of any loss carry-forward for the fraudulent year
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The statutory representative (chairperson/general manager) is named in criminal summons as the responsible person; tax arrears of the WFOE exceeding NT$1 million trigger a cross-border travel ban and asset freeze; directors become jointly civilly liable for restitution of the evaded tax plus interest if they signed or directed the false return

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance Failure / Shell Company Re-characterisation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the WFOE as a paper entity lacking a physical Taiwan office, employees, inventory custody, and management decisions; cross-border purchase and resale flows pass through Taiwan bookkeeping records solely to strip profits to the PRC parent at preferential estimated-profit or treaty-like rates
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: GAAR invocation under Tax Collection Act Article 12-1: re-characterisation of the transaction, deemed-profit method applied to the wholesale margin (10%–15% of gross invoices), additional tax assessed on the full difference, plus a 2x–3x administrative penalty; registrable deregistration of the WFOE by the Ministry of Economic Affairs
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors/statutory representatives are personally sued for recovery of the re-assessed tax and penalties on the grounds of appointment as legal representative; travel bans and restrictions on leaving Taiwan are imposed until settlement; a finding of sham structure is reported to Taiwan's FIU and may trigger parallel money-laundering prosecution

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Trade-Based Money Laundering Red Flags
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing Chinese wire-transfer payments for passive-electronics inventory without matching customs declarations, using sham forwarding agents, over/under-invoicing shipments between PRC affiliates and the Taiwan WFOE, or soliciting credit-line financing on the strength of artificial receivables
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of customer due diligence and suspicious transaction reporting duties under the Money Laundering Control Act: administrative fine up to NT$5 million and criminal sanction of imprisonment up to 2 years for deliberate non-reporting; trade-based money laundering is predicate to an offence punishable by imprisonment up to 7 years and fine up to NT$50 million for the enterprise
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorise or recklessly ignore red-flag wire flows face criminal liability as accomplices; corporate forfeiture of the laundered funds; personal travel bans, restraint orders, and extradition risks under cross-strait mutual legal assistance protocols; bank credit lines are immediately revoked and the directors become personally guarantors for the outstanding exposure

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Non-Disclosure of Related-Party Transactions
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the TP information return or attaching a false TNMM study where cross-border related-party purchases exceed NT$100 million; selecting a TP method that ignores the distributor's passive-risk profile; charging unreasonably low mark-ups on MLCC/resistor resales to the PRC parent or paying undisclosed management/royalty fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax bureau adjusts the profit under the most appropriate arm's-length method (usually TNMM on operating margin); the underpaid tax is assessed with a 2x administrative penalty, monthly 1% delay surcharge, and forfeiture of the favourable deemed-profit option; intentional concealment of the relationship raises the penalty to 3x
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Statutory representatives are personally liable to settle the adjusted tax and penalties before deregistration or dividend distribution abroad; the bureau may petition the court for conservatory seizure of the directors' personal assets and impose travel bans; a final determination that the WFOE is a conduit also exposes the parent PRC entity to joint collection within Taiwan's enforcement scope
